items.item: Uses guest user sharing rules and the guest profile's minimum object and field permissions
items.evidence: Uses a sharingGuestRules entry (Read, criteria IsActive = true) plus a guest profile with Product2 allowRead only and field-level read on Description, ProductCode and Family.

items.item: Warns against giving guests edit access or using without sharing broadly
items.evidence: "Don't give guests Edit (or Delete, View All, Modify All) on Product2" and "Don't use `without sharing` Apex or system-mode queries to show guests more."

items.item: Mentions that guest records are owned by a default internal owner (secure guest access settings)
items.evidence: "Records guests create are owned by the site's default internal owner. That setting is in the site's Preferences under secure guest user settings."
